scripts.setup: npm run check:env && pip install -r requirements.txt -r web/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "python web/main.py" "cd frontend && npm run dev" --names "API,UI" --prefix-colors "blue,green" --kill-others
scripts.start:localhost: npm run check:start && cd web && python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
